title: SemWeaver: Refining LLM-Generated Static Vulnerability Checkers with Analyzer-Internal Evidence
title_zh: SemWeaver：利用分析器内部证据精炼LLM生成的静态漏洞检查器

paragraphs.en: Recent work shows that LLMs can synthesize static-analysis checkers from security patches, but a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. A patch reveals what changed, not why the change is safe, so generated checkers often match only the surface edit and miss the deeper semantic condition. Existing refinement loops feed back compilation errors and validation reports, yet these signals describe symptoms without explaining what the checker misunderstands about the code.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究表明，大语言模型能够从安全补丁中合成静态分析检查器，但一个可编译的检查器并不一定是正确的检查器。 补丁揭示了什么发生了改变，却没有说明为什么这一改变是安全的，因此生成的检查器往往只匹配表面改动，而遗漏更深层的语义条件。 现有的迭代优化循环会把编译错误和验证报告反馈回去，但这些信号只描述了症状，并未解释检查器对代码的哪些理解出了偏差。

paragraphs.en: We observe that the analysis framework itself already computes the information needed to close this gap. Control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks are available inside the analyzer but unused by current refinement strategies. SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts patch-relevant analyzer evidence and assembles it with source context and validation feedback into a structured, provenance-labelled bundle. An iterative editing loop refines the checker on both the vulnerable and fixed revisions, guarded by a retention gate that accepts warning recovery or false-positive reduction while preventing over-pruning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，该分析框架本身已经计算出了弥补这一差距所需的信息。 控制流图、符号值、内存区域和检查器回调在分析器内部均可用，但未被当前的细化策略利用。 SemWeaver 是一个插件式的细化层，它提取与补丁相关的分析器证据，并将其与源代码上下文和验证反馈组装成一个带来源标注的结构化数据包。 迭代式编辑循环在易受攻击版本和已修复版本上对检查器进行细化，并由一个保留门控加以保护，该门控接受告警消除或误报减少，同时防止过度剪枝。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SemWeaver on 39 KNighter-derived CSA checkers from Linux kernel fixes. With analyzer evidence, refinement reaches 23 warning-positive vulnerable revisions (vs. 15 for KNighter’s loop) and raises version-level F 1 F_{1} from 0.448 0.448 to 0.575 0.575 . An ablation removing internal evidence recovers fewer silent cases and produces different checker edits, indicating that the two evidence configurations address complementary recognition gaps. Additional experiments cover three editor models on a 12-subject subset, a CodeQL query refinement, and controlled source-form variations. A qualitative follow-up on all 11 non-tied comparisons traces each warning-count change to a specific checker repair, such as recognizing a lowered callback or unwrapping an expression cast.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在来自 Linux 内核修复的 39 个 KNighter 派生的 CSA 检查器上评估 SemWeaver。 借助分析器证据，精炼达到 23 个警告为正的脆弱修订版本（相比之下 KNighter 的循环为 15 个），并将版本级 F 1 F_{1} 从 0.448 0.448 提升到 0.575 0.575 。 消融内部证据的消融实验恢复的静默案例更少，并产生不同的检查器编辑，这表明两种证据配置应对了互补的识别缺口。 额外实验包括在 12 个主题子集上测试三个编辑器模型、一次 CodeQL 查询精炼，以及受控的源码形式变化。 对全部 11 个非平局比较的定性后续分析将每次警告数量的变化追溯到特定的检查器修复，例如识别降级的回调或解包表达式强制转换。

paragraphs.en: Static analysis is a cornerstone of software security assurance for systems code. Tools such as CodeQL ( GitHub, 2026 ) and Clang Static Analyzer (CSA) ( LLVM Project, 2026 ) detect vulnerabilities by checking source code against predefined rules without executing it ( Engler et al., 2001 ; Bessey et al., 2010 ; Calcagno et al., 2015 ; Sadowski et al., 2015 ) . The effectiveness of these tools depends on the quality of their vulnerability checkers, each of which must encode the semantic conditions that distinguish a real bug from safe code. Writing such checkers by hand requires expertise in both the target codebase and the analysis framework, making manual authoring expensive and difficult to scale.
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析是系统代码软件安全保障的基石。 诸如 CodeQL（GitHub，2026）和 Clang 静态分析器（CSA）（LLVM Project，2026）之类的工具，通过依据预定义规则检查源代码而无需执行代码来检测漏洞（Engler et al., 2001；Bessey et al., 2010；Calcagno et al., 2015；Sadowski et al., 2015）。 这些工具的有效性取决于其漏洞检查器的质量，每个检查器都必须编码区分真实缺陷与安全代码的语义条件。 手工编写此类检查器需要同时具备目标代码库和分析框架方面的专业知识，这使得人工编写成本高昂且难以扩展。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based patch-driven synthesis offers a promising alternative. In this paradigm, a security patch serves as a compact before-and-after specification: the LLM consumes the patch and synthesizes a checker that should fire on the vulnerable revision but remain silent on the fixed revision. KNighter ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , a representative system, has demonstrated that this approach can produce compilable and executable CSA checkers from historical Linux kernel fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的补丁驱动合成提供了一种有前景的替代方案。 在这一范式中，安全补丁充当了一种紧凑的前后对比规范：大语言模型读取补丁并合成一个检查器，该检查器应在存在漏洞的版本上触发，而在修复后的版本上保持沉默。 KNighter（Yang et al., 2025）作为一个代表性系统，已经证明了这种方法能够从历史上的 Linux 内核修复中生成可编译、可执行的 CSA 检查器。

sents.zh: 基于大语言模型的补丁驱动合成提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: However, a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. The difficulty is that a patch shows what changed in the code, but not why the change makes the code safe. Consider a one-character fix that tightens a loop bound from i < N to i < N -1 : the real reason this works is that it prevents an array access at i +1 from exceeding the array’s capacity. A checker that merely looks for the old loop bound but does not understand the array access behind it will either report both versions or detect neither. Attempting to fix such a checker can also backfire: edits that suppress spurious reports may simultaneously remove the trigger for the true bug, a failure mode we call over-pruning.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一个可编译的检查器并不一定是正确的检查器。 困难在于，补丁只显示了代码中改了什么，却没有说明为什么这个改动能让代码变得安全。 考虑一个单字符修复，它把循环边界从 i < N 收紧为 i < N -1：这一修复之所以有效，真正的原因是它防止了在 i +1 处的数组访问超出数组的容量。 一个仅仅查找旧循环边界、却不理解其背后数组访问的检查器，要么对两个版本都报警，要么对两个版本都漏检。 试图修复这样的检查器也可能适得其反：为消除误报而做的修改，可能同时移除了真正缺陷的触发条件，这种失败模式我们称之为过度剪枝（over-pruning）。

paragraphs.en: A natural response is to iteratively refine the checker using feedback. Existing strategies, including KNighter’s own loop, feed compilation errors and validation reports back to the LLM so it can edit the checker ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Yet this feedback only describes symptoms. A message such as “the vulnerable side is silent” tells the model that something is wrong, but not what the checker misunderstands about the code. A cleanup attribute may name a lowered callback that the checker never recognizes. A cast may hide the expression expected by a callback. A state lookup may use a different region from the preceding update.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的做法是利用反馈迭代地改进检查器。 现有策略，包括 KNighter 自身的循环，会将编译错误和验证报告反馈给大语言模型，以便其修改检查器 ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) 。 然而这种反馈只描述了症状。 诸如「易受攻击的一侧是静默的」这样的消息只是告诉模型出了问题，却没有说明检查器对代码的哪一点存在误解。 一个 cleanup 属性可能命名了一个检查器从未识别的下降后回调。 一次类型转换可能隐藏了回调所期望的表达式。 一次状态查找可能使用了与先前更新不同的区域。

paragraphs.en: Our key observation is that the analysis framework itself already computes the semantic information needed to close this gap, but existing refinement loops do not use it . CSA, for example, exposes control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks. CodeQL provides similar depth through its program database and queries ( Avgustinov et al., 2016 ; GitHub, 2026 ) . This information can reveal why a checker misses a vulnerability, not just that it does. The challenge is selecting the relevant parts of this rich output and relating them to the patch and the checker under refinement.

paragraphs.en: We present SemWeaver , a refinement framework that bridges this gap by feeding analyzer-internal evidence into the LLM’s editing loop. Where existing refinement loops rely primarily on compilation and report feedback, SemWeaver additionally extracts semantic context from the analyzer itself: a rule-guided preflight selects patch-relevant views such as control-flow structure, symbolic-value bindings and checker callback traces, so the model can see what the checker actually observes at runtime rather than guess from silence alone. These facts are assembled with source context and validation feedback into a typed evidence bundle with explicit provenance, giving the model a structured diagnosis instead of a flat error log. The agent then edits the checker and validates it on both revisions, guarded by a retention gate that accepts warning recovery or false-positive reduction but rejects edits that lose an existing vulnerable-side warning, directly countering the over-pruning problem.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SemWeaver，一个精化框架，它通过将分析器内部的证据馈入大语言模型（LLM）的编辑循环来弥合这一差距。 现有的精化循环主要依赖编译和报告反馈，而 SemWeaver 还额外从分析器自身提取语义上下文：一个由规则引导的预检步骤会选择与补丁相关的视图，例如控制流结构、符号值绑定以及检查器回调轨迹，使模型能够看到检查器在运行时实际观察到的内容，而不是仅凭沉默去猜测。 这些事实与源代码上下文和验证反馈一起，被组装成一个带有显式来源信息的类型化证据包，为模型提供结构化的诊断，而不是平铺的错误日志。 随后，智能体对检查器进行编辑，并在两个版本上对其进行验证，同时由一个保留门控加以保护：该门控接受警告恢复或误报减少的修改，但拒绝会丢失已有易受攻击侧警告的编辑，从而直接应对过度剪枝问题。

sents.zh: 我们提出 SemWeaver，一个精化框架，它通过将分析器内部的证据馈入大语言模型（LLM）的编辑循环来弥合这一差距。

sents.zh: 现有的精化循环主要依赖编译和报告反馈，而 SemWeaver 还额外从分析器自身提取语义上下文：一个由规则引导的预检步骤会选择与补丁相关的视图，例如控制流结构、符号值绑定以及检查器回调轨迹，使模型能够看到检查器在运行时实际观察到的内容，而不是仅凭沉默去猜测。

sents.en: These facts are assembled with source context and validation feedback into a typed evidence bundle with explicit provenance, giving the model a structured diagnosis instead of a flat error log.
sents.zh: 这些事实与源代码上下文和验证反馈一起，被组装成一个带有显式来源信息的类型化证据包，为模型提供结构化的诊断，而不是平铺的错误日志。

sents.en: The agent then edits the checker and validates it on both revisions, guarded by a retention gate that accepts warning recovery or false-positive reduction but rejects edits that lose an existing vulnerable-side warning, directly countering the over-pruning problem.
sents.zh: 随后，智能体对检查器进行编辑，并在两个版本上对其进行验证，同时由一个保留门控加以保护：该门控接受警告恢复或误报减少的修改，但拒绝会丢失已有易受攻击侧警告的编辑，从而直接应对过度剪枝问题。

We define analyzer-internal evidence by its backend origin, extraction interface and source binding, and study how it can guide edits to an existing checker rather than regenerate one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现配对警告反馈与分析器对生成检查器所检查代码的表示之间存在差距。 我们依据后端来源、提取接口和源绑定来定义分析器内部证据，并研究它如何指导对现有检查器的编辑，而不是重新生成一个检查器。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we build SemWeaver as an end-to-end plug-in refinement system. It selects patch-relevant views, joins analyzer, source and validation records in a typed, provenance-labelled bundle, and iteratively edits, compiles and scans the detector on both revisions. paragraphs.en: We then evaluate all 39 selected generated-only Linux CSA checkers from the same starting artifacts, comparing the actual KNighter refinement loop with native and no-internal refinement. Native recovers eight initially silent vulnerable revisions; the ablation without internal evidence recovers six, with each arm repairing cases the other does not, indicating that internal and source-derived evidence address complementary recognition gaps. We also repeat the evidence comparison on 12 subjects, run three editor configurations three times on that subset, refine an archived CodeQL query in three decodes, and inspect all 11 non-tied comparisons alongside controlled source changes. These analyses trace each warning-count change to a specific checker repair, such as recognizing a lowered callback or unwrapping an expression cast.

paragraphs.en: This section introduces the background on static vulnerability checkers, LLM-based checker generation from security patches, and the analyzer-internal intermediate results that motivate our approach.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍静态漏洞检查器的背景、基于安全补丁的 LLM 检查器生成，以及促使我们提出该方法的分析器内部中间结果。

paragraphs.en: Static analysis examines source code without executing it, aiming to find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code-quality issues at compile time or during code review ( Engler et al., 2001 ; Bessey et al., 2010 ) . A vulnerability checker is a rule or query within a static-analysis framework that flags program locations matching a security-relevant condition. Modern frameworks support different checker paradigms. Path-sensitive engines such as CSA explore program paths, tracking branch guards, symbolic values and memory regions ( LLVM Project, 2026 ) . Relational query engines such as CodeQL express checkers as queries over extracted program facts ( Avgustinov et al., 2016 ; GitHub, 2026 ) . Both paradigms have been deployed at industrial scale ( Sadowski et al., 2015 ; Calcagno et al., 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析在不执行程序的情况下检查源代码，旨在在编译时或代码评审阶段发现缺陷、安全漏洞和代码质量问题（Engler et al., 2001；Bessey et al., 2010）。 漏洞检查器是静态分析框架中的一条规则或查询，用于标记符合安全相关条件的程序位置。 现代框架支持不同的检查器范式。 路径敏感引擎（如 CSA）通过探索程序路径来跟踪分支守卫、符号值和内存区域（LLVM Project, 2026）。 关系型查询引擎（如 CodeQL）将检查器表达为对提取出的程序事实的查询（Avgustinov et al., 2016；GitHub, 2026）。 这两种范式都已在工业规模上得到部署（Sadowski et al., 2015；Calcagno et al., 2015）。

sents.zh: 关系型查询引擎（如 CodeQL）将检查器表达为对提取出的程序事实的查询（Avgustinov et al., 2016；GitHub, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Even so, writing effective checkers remains a bottleneck. A checker must encode the conditions that distinguish a real bug from a safe use of the same operation. It must also express those conditions through the framework’s callbacks, values and object representations. The resulting warning burden affects practical use ( Johnson et al., 2013 ; Heckman and Williams, 2011 ) . Warning ranking and actionability prediction help users inspect reports ( Kremenek and Engler, 2003 ; Ruthruff et al., 2008 ) ; checker refinement changes the code that produces them.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，编写有效的检查器仍然是一个瓶颈。 检查器必须编码用于区分真实缺陷与同一操作的安全用法之间的条件。 它还必须通过该框架的回调、值和对象表示来表达这些条件。 由此产生的警告负担影响了实际使用（Johnson 等，2013；Heckman 和 Williams，2011）。 警告排序与可操作性预测帮助用户检查报告（Kremenek 和 Engler，2003；Ruthruff 等，2008）；而检查器改进则改变了产生这些报告的代码。

sents.zh: 尽管如此，编写有效的检查器仍然是一个瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: A security patch provides a compact before-and-after specification: the vulnerable revision should trigger the generated checker, and the fixed revision should not. This idea builds on work that treats patches as vulnerability specifications, including semantic patching ( Padioleau et al., 2008 ) , clone-based vulnerability discovery ( Jang et al., 2012 ; Kim et al., 2017 ) , and patch-derived datasets ( Fan et al., 2020 ) . KNighter ( Yang et al., 2025 ) synthesizes CSA checkers from historical Linux fixes and already refines them using compiler feedback, diagnostic and report-path context, and validation on both revisions. Its no-report branch provides no report-driven edit.
paragraphs.zh: 安全补丁提供了一种紧凑的前后对照规约：存在漏洞的版本应触发生成的检查器，而已修复的版本则不应触发。 这一想法建立在将补丁视为漏洞规约的相关工作之上，包括语义补丁（Padioleau et al., 2008）、基于克隆的漏洞发现（Jang et al., 2012；Kim et al., 2017）以及源自补丁的数据集（Fan et al., 2020）。 KNighter（Yang et al., 2025）从 Linux 的历史修复中合成 CSA 检查器，并已利用编译器反馈、诊断与报告路径上下文以及对两个版本的验证来对其进行精炼。 其无报告分支不提供任何基于报告的编辑。

sents.en: A security patch provides a compact before-and-after specification: the vulnerable revision should trigger the generated checker, and the fixed revision should not.
sents.zh: 安全补丁提供了一种紧凑的前后对照规约：存在漏洞的版本应触发生成的检查器，而已修复的版本则不应触发。

sents.zh: KNighter（Yang et al., 2025）从 Linux 的历史修复中合成 CSA 检查器，并已利用编译器反馈、诊断与报告路径上下文以及对两个版本的验证来对其进行精炼。

paragraphs.en: A patch describes a particular repair rather than every safe and unsafe use of an operation. The generated checker may therefore omit an important condition or encode it incorrectly. SemWeaver retains the patch-driven setting and adds analyzer context to the editing loop, including recovery attempts when the starting checker is silent.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁描述的是某一次特定的修复，而不是一个操作所有安全与不安全的使用方式。 因此，生成的检查器可能会遗漏某个重要条件，或者将其错误地编码。 SemWeaver 保留了补丁驱动的设定，并在编辑循环中加入分析器上下文，包括在起始检查器不报错时的恢复尝试。

sents.zh: 补丁描述的是某一次特定的修复，而不是一个操作所有安全与不安全的使用方式。

Their interpretation depends on their source: a compiler-produced record, an emitted diagnostic and a source window supply different kinds of information. Section 4.1 defines these origins and the interfaces used in our implementation.

paragraphs.en: We illustrate the refinement process end to end on a single case: the KNighter-derived CSA checker for Linux commit 97cba232549b , which repairs an off-by-one access in the AMD display driver ( Shanmugam, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . This case is small enough to inspect manually yet exhibits the core problem: the generated checker recognizes a look-ahead access but misses the relation between the loop bound and the array’s capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个单一案例上端到端地展示该精炼过程：基于 KNighter 的 CSA 检查器，针对 Linux 提交 97cba232549b，它修复了 AMD 显示驱动程序中的一次差一访问（Shanmugam, 2024; Yang et al., 2025）。 该案例规模足够小以便手动检查，同时又体现了核心问题：生成的检查器能够识别前瞻式访问，却遗漏了循环边界与数组容量之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: The bug and its patch. The array dc -> links has a declared capacity of MAX_PIPES * 2 , abbreviated as N N in Figure 1 ( ➊ ). The function get_host_router_total_dp_tunnel_bw iterates over these links. On a matching host-router branch, the loop body reads both links [ i ] and links [ i + 1] (M10–M11, ➌ ). Under the original bound i < N i<N (M5, ➋ ), the loop allows i = N − 1 i=N-1 , so the look-ahead reaches index N N and overflows the array. The patch tightens the bound to i < N − 1 i<N-1 (M6, ➍ ), capping the largest look-ahead index at N − 1 N-1 .
paragraphs.zh: 该漏洞及其补丁。 数组 dc -> links 的声明容量为 MAX_PIPES * 2，在图 1（➊）中缩写为 N N。 函数 get_host_router_total_dp_tunnel_bw 会遍历这些链路。 在匹配到主机-路由器分支时，循环体同时读取 links [ i ] 和 links [ i + 1]（M10–M11，➌）。 在原来的边界 i < N i<N（M5，➋）下，循环允许 i = N − 1 i=N-1，因此前瞻读取会到达索引 N N 并越界溢出该数组。 补丁将边界收紧为 i < N − 1 i<N-1（M6，➍），把最大的前瞻索引限制在 N − 1 N-1。

paragraphs.en: Why the baseline checker fails. The generated checker already recognizes an induction variable, a loop bound, and a look-ahead subscript. It warns whenever the access lacks a protective condition in an enclosing if (B1–B5, ➎ ). This rule checks only the branch guards and overlooks the protection carried by the loop bound itself. Because the fixed program still contains links [ i + 1] , the checker fires on both revisions despite the tighter bound, yielding 1/1 alerts in independent replay. KNighter’s own refinement loop does not change this checker: its report-driven policy finds no actionable feedback on this case, so the output remains 1/1 . In short, the checker has learned that a look-ahead access needs a guard, but not that the loop condition already provides one.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么基线检查器会失败。 生成的检查器已经能够识别归纳变量、循环边界和前向引用下标。 每当该访问在外层 if 中缺少保护条件时，它就会发出警告（B1–B5，➎）。 这条规则只检查分支守卫，而忽略了循环边界本身所提供的保护。 由于修复后的程序仍然包含 links[i + 1]，即使边界收紧了，检查器在两个修订版本上仍然触发，在独立重放中产生 1/1 的告警。 KNighter 自身的精炼循环不会改变这个检查器：其基于报告的策略在此案例中找不到可操作的反馈，因此输出仍为 1/1。 简而言之，该检查器学到了前向访问需要守卫，却没有学到循环条件本身已经提供了这一守卫。

Specifically, it collects four evidence records: two from Clang 18 internals (a CFG dump via debug.DumpCFG and a call graph via debug.DumpCallGraph ) and two from analyzer output. paragraphs.en: With this evidence, the LLM adds a capacity-aware condition to the existing checkASTCodeBody traversal. The refined checker reads the declared array extent from the AST type and computes the maximum look-ahead index: for a loop i < B i<B , that index is ( B − 1 ) + 1 = B (B-1)+1=B . It suppresses the warning when B B is smaller than the array extent N N (C3–C6, ➏ ). Under the vulnerable bound B = N B=N , the maximum index equals the extent, so the warning fires. Under the fixed bound B = N − 1 B=N-1 , the maximum index is safely below the extent, so the checker stays silent. Crucially, this condition is based on type and index relations rather than the patched function name, a specific capacity constant, or adjacency of statements. The first candidate passes independent Linux replay at 1/0 .
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一证据，大语言模型（LLM）在现有的 checkASTCodeBody 遍历中加入了一个容量感知的条件。 改进后的检查器从 AST 类型中读取声明的数组范围，并计算最大前瞻索引：对于循环 i < B i<B，该索引为 ( B − 1 ) + 1 = B (B-1)+1=B。 当 B B 小于数组范围 N N 时，它会抑制该警告（C3–C6，➏）。 在存在漏洞的边界 B = N B=N 下，最大索引等于数组范围，因此会触发警告。 在修复后的边界 B = N − 1 B=N-1 下，最大索引安全地低于数组范围，因此检查器保持静默。 关键在于，该条件基于类型与索引之间的关系，而不是被修补的函数名、某个特定的容量常量或语句的相邻性。 第一个候选方案以 1/0 的结果通过了独立的 Linux 重放验证。

paragraphs.en: Benefits over the baseline. The refined checker offers two concrete advantages over KNighter’s refined output. First, higher precision on the original Linux pair: SemWeaver ’s checker correctly reports 1/0 (warns on the vulnerable revision, stays silent on the fixed one), whereas KNighter’s checker remains at 1/1 because it never learned the bound-to-capacity relation. Second, better generalization: on 114 controlled C programs built from the same look-ahead pattern (with varied names, capacities, unrelated statements, and loop-bound formulations), SemWeaver ’s checker gives the expected result on all 114 executions (58 unsafe warned, 56 safe silent), while the checker produced by KNighter’s refinement loop correctly handles only 31 unsafe and 25 safe cases. AddressSanitizer independently confirms the safety labels for 80 of these variations ( Serebryany et al., 2012 ) . Both advantages stem from the same root cause: analyzer evidence (CFG and call-graph context) lets the model understand why the loop bound matters for safety, so the refined checker encodes a semantic condition (maximum index vs. array extent) rather than matching syntactic patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 相对于基线的优势。 精炼后的检查器相比 KNighter 的精炼输出具有两个具体优势。 首先，在原始 Linux 对上具有更高的精确率：SemWeaver 的检查器正确地报告了 1/0（对易受攻击的版本发出警告，对已修复的版本保持沉默），而 KNighter 的检查器仍停留在 1/1，因为它从未学到边界与容量的关系。 其次，泛化能力更好：在由相同的预读模式构建的 114 个受控 C 程序上（名称、容量、无关语句和循环边界表述各不相同），SemWeaver 的检查器在全部 114 次执行中都给出了预期结果（58 个不安全程序被警告，56 个安全程序保持沉默），而 KNighter 的精炼循环产生的检查器仅能正确处理 31 个不安全用例和 25 个安全用例。 AddressSanitizer 独立确认了其中 80 个变体的安全性标签（Serebryany et al., 2012）。 这两个优势源于同一个根本原因：分析器证据（CFG 和调用图上下文）让模型理解了为什么循环边界对安全性至关重要，因此精炼后的检查器编码的是语义条件（最大索引与数组范围的比较），而不是匹配句法模式。

paragraphs.en: SemWeaver is a post-synthesis refinement layer for LLM-generated vulnerability detectors. Given a draft CSA checker or CodeQL query produced by an upstream generator, the patch that motivated the synthesis, and the corresponding source tree and validation scope, SemWeaver refines the detector to recover vulnerable-side warnings or reduce fixed-side reports.
paragraphs.zh: SemWeaver 是一个针对 LLM 生成的漏洞检测器的合成后精炼层。 给定由上游生成器产出的草稿 CSA 检查器或 CodeQL 查询、触发该合成过程的补丁，以及对应的源码树和验证范围，SemWeaver 会精炼该检测器，以恢复易受攻击一侧的告警或减少已修复一侧的报告。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes the workflow across five stages. (a) Generator context. SemWeaver receives a draft detector, patch, source tree and validation target. It treats the generator as a black box and refines its output in place. (b) Evidence assembly. Rule-guided preflight selects evidence requirements, and four collectors gather patch facts, source context, analyzer evidence and validation feedback. (c) Evidence bundle schema. The facts are normalized into typed records with their origin and source bindings. (d) Paired-Warning Refinement. The agent edits the latest attempt using a bounded view of those records. Paired validation updates a separate best retained detector. (e) Audit artifacts. Each run persists evidence, prompts, replies, candidates and validation results, so a refinement can be inspected or resumed. The audit links the retained checker to the evidence shown, attempted edits and paired outcomes; RQ3 compares refinement with and without native evidence.

paragraphs.en: Analyzer-internal evidence. A path-sensitive analyzer does not just emit a final warning: along the way it builds control-flow graphs, tracks symbolic values and region bindings, resolves call edges, and maintains checker-specific state transitions. These intermediate results are richer than the final diagnostic and cannot be recovered from source code alone. We call evidence extracted from them analyzer-internal , distinguishing it from source-derived evidence (patch diffs and source windows) and analyzer-output evidence (diagnostics and validation reports).

paragraphs.en: Evidence collection. Four collectors run in sequence (Figure 2 b, top to bottom). Patch preflight parses affected files, hunks and statements, establishing what changed and where . Analyzer evidence captures intermediate results from the backend. In our CSA study, the collector invokes Clang 18’s debug.DumpCFG and debug.DumpCallGraph to obtain CFG branches, value bindings and call edges, and instruments CSA callbacks to observe abstract values, region bindings and checker-state associations during path exploration. These are observations of the checker’s own analysis, not concrete executions of the program under test. Instrumented scans must preserve diagnostics on both revisions; we verify revision, source scope and diagnostic parity, and mark unavailable observations explicitly. Validation feedback records whether the current detector compiles, executes, warns on the vulnerable revision and stays silent on the fixed revision, supplying the failure symptom for the next edit.

paragraphs.en: Provenance classification. Each collected record is classified by its origin into three categories (Table 1 ). paragraphs.en: Feedback loop. When a candidate fails to compile or improve the retained result, its code and feedback remain available for the next attempt. The agent edits the latest attempt, while D ∗ D^{*} stores the best retained checker. paragraphs.en: Subjects and benchmarks. We organize the evaluation into four experiments (E1–E4). E1 uses KNighter-derived Linux CSA checkers under patch-related object validation. From 286 artifact records on 60 commits, 241 records on 39 commits lack an upstream refinement-status row. We select one nonempty repaired-source artifact per commit by upstream TP, then TN, then the lowest checker index. This fixed, non-random rule selects the inputs; independent paired replay supplies their starting outcomes. All 39 enter KNighter refinement and both SemWeaver variants, including cases that remain noisy or fail to improve. Initially, 15 checkers warn on both revisions and 24 are silent on both. Their zero starting PDS is the study’s entry state.
paragraphs.zh: 实验对象与基准。 我们将评估组织为四个实验（E1–E4）。 E1 使用由 KNighter 派生的 Linux CSA 检查器，并施加与补丁相关的对象验证。 在 60 个提交上的 286 条工件记录中，有 39 个提交上的 241 条记录缺少上游的精化状态行。 我们按上游 TP、其次 TN、再次最小检查器编号的顺序，为每个提交选择一个非空的修复后源码工件。 这条固定的、非随机的规则用于选取输入；独立的成对重放提供它们的起始结果。 全部 39 个都进入 KNighter 精化以及两个 SemWeaver 变体，包括那些仍然带噪声或未能改进的情况。 初始时，15 个检查器在两个版本上均报警，24 个在两个版本上均沉默。 它们为零的起始 PDS 是本研究的入口状态。

paragraphs.en: Experimental procedure. For each sample, we collect evidence, refine the detector and validate it on both revisions. Each permitted reply counts as an attempt. Compilable changed candidates receive independent paired replay and are retained under Equation 3 . The next call receives the latest attempted code and feedback; the best retained detector is stored separately. The loop stops when a vulnerable warning and fixed-side silence are achieved, after three valid validations without improvement, after three consecutive invalid model attempts, or at the reply cap.
paragraphs.zh: 实验流程。 对于每个样本，我们收集证据，改进检测器，并在两个版本上进行验证。 每次允许的回复都算作一次尝试。 可编译的变更候选会获得独立的成对重放，并按照公式 3 被保留。 下一次调用会收到最近一次尝试的代码和反馈；被保留的最佳检测器则单独存储。 当达成“漏洞侧出现警告且修复侧保持静默”时，或在三次有效验证均无改进后，或在连续三次无效的模型尝试后，或在达到回复上限时，循环停止。

paragraphs.en: Controlled source replay. Beyond model variation, we examine source changes in three selected original subjects, G01, G08 and G09; their unchanged-source controls reproduce the original paired counts. Local renaming and inert no-ops leave counts unchanged in these cases. Under the equivalent guard rewrite, native retains vulnerable-side warning presence in eight of nine case–change pairs: G01 falls from 2 / 2 2/2 to 0 / 0 0/0 , G08 rises from 1 / 1 1/1 to 2 / 2 2/2 , and G09 remains 1 / 1 1/1 . Thus the loss of two fixed-side reports in G01 is also a loss of its vulnerable warning, while G08’s preserved warning costs another fixed-side report. These controlled changes identify source-form sensitivity without treating the three subjects as independent natural evolution events.

paragraphs.en: To validate whether warning-level improvements reflect genuine semantic understanding, we conduct three supplementary analyses. First, a target and report audit inspects all 11 non-tied native/no-internal comparisons across 362 report occurrences and 22 code diffs, classifying each report by target association and source support. Second, mechanism probes construct six controlled variants per case for G12, G19, G24 and G25 (48 files, 96 scans), and a separate intervention replaces native-observation lines with missing markers to test whether evidence removal changes the model’s editing decisions. Third, a controlled source replay rescans three subjects under local renames, inert no-ops and equivalent guard rewrites to measure source-form sensitivity without re-invoking the model.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证警告级别的改进是否反映了真正的语义理解，我们进行了三项补充分析。 首先，目标与报告审计检查了 362 次报告出现和 22 个代码差异中的全部 11 个非平局的 native/no-internal 比较，并按目标关联和来源支持对每份报告进行分类。 其次，机制探针为 G12、G19、G24 和 G25 构建了每个案例六个受控变体（48 个文件，96 次扫描），另一项干预将 native-observation 行替换为缺失标记，以测试证据移除是否会改变智能体的编辑决策。 第三，受控来源重放在本地重命名、惰性 no-op 和等效的守卫重写下重新扫描三个受试者，以在不重新调用智能体的情况下衡量对源代码形式的敏感性。

The quantitative results match several distinct changes in the checkers. Among the six native benefits, G12/G19/G25 have bounded source-supported target reports, G09 has conditional support, and G24/G35 retain no supported or conditional target report. paragraphs.en: Both G01 variants repair recognition of the governing loop, but only no-internal checks the preceding capacity guard. G19 adds a lowered cleanup name. G23 changes symbol and nested-member lookup; G25 changes sink recognition and destination binding. These repairs make the intended operation visible to the checker. Other edits relax predicates: G05 preserves initialization uncertainty, G09 broadens cleanup handling, G12 drops actor restrictions, and G38 combines field-region preservation with a looser usage gate. G35’s new trigger instead reports on an initialized overflow parameter outside the patched target.

paragraphs.en: The negative cases are equally important. Correcting the callback or expression recognized by a checker can activate a useful check, yet leave the object, guard or owning scope wrong. paragraphs.en: Scope of improvement. SemWeaver refines a detector with respect to its motivating patch. A human-written checker could use the same interface with a compatible backend, patch and validation pair. We study generated inputs, for which the patch supplies a common refinement target. A checker may know where to warn yet miss why the warning should disappear after the fix. Our results show that refinement also has an earlier task: making the checker recognize the relevant operation in the analyzer’s representation. G19 needs the lowered cleanup callback; G25 needs to look through an expression wrapper. These are useful repairs, but the remaining scope and path conditions still determine whether a warning is justified.
paragraphs.zh: 改进空间。 SemWeaver 针对其动机补丁对检测器进行精化。 人工编写的检查器可以使用相同的接口，配合兼容的后端、补丁和验证对。 我们研究生成的输入，对这类输入而言，补丁提供了一个共同的精化目标。 检查器可能知道在哪里告警，却未能理解为什么修复之后该告警应当消失。 我们的结果表明，精化还有一个更早的任务：让检查器在分析器的表示中识别出相关操作。 G19 需要 lowered 之后的清理回调；G25 需要透过表达式包装器进行查看。 这些都是有用的修复，但剩余的范围和路径条件仍决定告警是否合理。

paragraphs.en: Evidence as context compression. The relevant condition may span source code and analyzer outputs. Passing the full repository to the model is impractical, while passing only the patch may leave out the representation seen by the checker. SemWeaver collects a provenance-tagged summary of patch-relevant facts and makes it available with validation feedback. The interface follows the general idea of refining an artifact under additional program evidence ( Clarke et al., 2000 ; Solar-Lezama et al., 2006 ; Nguyen et al., 2013 ; Mechtaev et al., 2016 ; Long and Rinard, 2016 ) . The native and no-internal arms repair different representation problems (e.g., G19/G25 vs. G01/G23/G38), suggesting that analyzer-internal and source-derived evidence address complementary gaps.

paragraphs.en: Failure modes. Over-pruning is one failure mode, but retaining a warning is not enough either. In G24, fewer fixed-side reports coexist with surviving reports outside the intended lifecycle. In G19, a broader cleanup matcher can report at a callee return while the caller’s variable is still live. In G25, a recovered target-line warning can follow an explicitly non-NULL path. These cases suggest reporting the actual checker edit, the property supported by its diagnostic, and the change in inspection burden together. This separates successful recognition from the semantic conditions still needing repair.

paragraphs.en: Internal. An error in evidence collection, editing or validation could produce a spurious improvement. To mitigate this, we retain raw outputs, code hashes, failed attempts and unavailable observations for every run; all scored checker edits are fully automatic and reproducible from the persisted artifacts. Native context bundles several components, which limits attribution to any single evidence type. The checkpoint intervention (Section 6.5 ) isolates selected clues while holding other context constant, and the fixture guard present in native but absent from no-internal rejects no E1/E3 candidate. Decoding variance from model aliases and the absence of a fixed seed is partially addressed by running three independent decodes per configuration; the variation across decodes is reported explicitly in RQ3 and RQ4.
paragraphs.zh: 内部使用。 证据收集、编辑或验证中的错误可能产生虚假的改进。 为缓解这一问题，我们为每次运行保留原始输出、代码哈希、失败的尝试以及不可用的观测；所有已评分的检查器编辑都是全自动的，并且可以从持久化的产物中完整复现。 原生上下文捆绑了多个组件，这限制了对任何单一证据类型的归因。 检查点干预（第 6.5 节）在其他上下文保持不变的情况下隔离选定的线索，而存在于原生设置中但不存在于无内部设置中的夹具防护不会拒绝任何 E1/E3 候选。 模型别名带来的解码方差以及缺乏固定种子的问题，通过对每个配置运行三次独立解码得到部分解决；各次解码之间的差异在 RQ3 和 RQ4 中被明确报告。

paragraphs.en: Construct. The primary metrics describe warnings on vulnerable and fixed revisions under the same patch-related scope, not target-level precision or confirmed false-positive bugs. This is a deliberate choice: version-level warning presence is the metric available without manual triage of every report, and it aligns with the paired-validation protocol that upstream generators already use. The qualitative follow-up (Section 6.5 ) adds source-level target audits and mechanism probes to assess whether warning-count changes reflect genuine semantic repairs; these judgments complement the quantitative scores without replacing them. Final-line matching cannot distinguish two objects or a feasible and infeasible path on the same line; we note this when interpreting individual cases (G08, G24) rather than treating all warnings as equivalent.
paragraphs.zh: 构建。 主要指标描述的是同一补丁相关范围内易受攻击版本与已修复版本上的告警情况，而非目标级别的精确度或已确认的误报告警。 这是一个刻意的选择：版本级别的告警存在性是无需对每份报告进行人工分诊即可获得的指标，并且它与上游生成器已经使用的配对验证协议保持一致。 定性后续分析（第 6.5 节）增加了源代码级别的目标审计和机制探查，以评估告警数量的变化是否反映了真正的语义修复；这些判断是对定量评分的补充，而非替代。 末行匹配无法区分同一行上的两个对象，也无法区分同一行上的可行路径与不可行路径；我们在解读个别案例（G08、G24）时会注明这一点，而不是将所有告警视为等同。

paragraphs.en: External. The 39 subjects come from one generator’s Linux artifacts, which bounds the diversity of checker styles and vulnerability types. Within this scope, the subjects cover five patch mechanisms (Table 2 ), exercise both silent and noisy starting conditions, and include cases where internal evidence helps, hurts, or makes no difference. The model study uses three decodes per configuration on 12 subjects, sufficient to reveal cross-decode variation but not to rank models with statistical confidence. The CodeQL experiment demonstrates cross-backend feasibility on one patch-local example; broader transfer remains future work. The controlled source replay covers three subjects and tests source-form sensitivity rather than representing independent natural evolution.

paragraphs.en: Conclusion. Repeated decodes and transformed fixtures are correlated observations, not additional independent bugs; we interpret them as stability checks rather than as expanding the effective sample size. The findings characterize local repairs and failures within the studied cohort; they do not estimate prevalence across arbitrary checkers or establish a rule predicting when internal evidence will help.
paragraphs.zh: 结论。 重复解码与转换后的测试夹具是相关联的观察结果，而非额外的独立缺陷；我们将其解读为稳定性检验，而不是扩大有效样本量。 这些发现刻画的是所研究样本内局部修复与失败的情况；它们并未估计在任何任意检查器中的普遍程度，也未确立一条预测内部证据何时会有用的规则。

sents.zh: 结论。

paragraphs.en: Static Analysis and Checker Languages. Static-analysis systems provide the substrate that SemWeaver refines against. Path-sensitive analyzers, abstract interpreters, and symbolic engines expose guards, states, paths, and diagnostics reusable as evidence ( Engler et al., 2001 ; Ball and Rajamani, 2002 ; Cousot et al., 2005 ; Cadar et al., 2008 ) and deploy at industrial scale ( Calcagno et al., 2015 ; Bessey et al., 2010 ; Sadowski et al., 2015 ) . Declarative languages offer a complementary approach by querying program facts through relational rules and points-to specifications ( Avgustinov et al., 2016 ; Jordan et al., 2016 ; Bravenboer and Smaragdakis, 2009 ) , while semantic patching encodes recurring transformations over systems code ( Padioleau et al., 2008 ) . SemWeaver introduces no new analyzer or query language. It treats generated checker code as the artifact to be refined.
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析与检查器语言。 静态分析系统为 SemWeaver 提供了其所依托的基础底座。 路径敏感分析器、抽象解释器和符号执行引擎能够暴露可作为证据复用的卫式条件、状态、路径与诊断信息（ Engler 等，2001 ；Ball 和 Rajamani，2002 ；Cousot 等，2005 ；Cadar 等，2008 ），并已在工业规模上部署（ Calcagno 等，2015 ；Bessey 等，2010 ；Sadowski 等，2015 ）。 声明式语言通过关系规则和指向规范查询程序事实，提供了一种互补的方法（ Avgustinov 等，2016 ；Jordan 等，2016 ；Bravenboer 和 Smaragdakis，2009 ），而语义补丁则将针对系统代码的重复性变换进行编码（ Padioleau 等，2008 ）。 SemWeaver 不引入新的分析器或查询语言。 它将生成的检查器代码视为有待精炼的工件。

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability Detection and Patch Evidence. Static vulnerability detection has long used taint and data-flow reasoning ( Livshits and Lam, 2005 ; Jovanovic et al., 2006 ; Arzt et al., 2014 ) , graph and AST representations ( Yamaguchi et al., 2014 ; Yamaguchi et al., 2012 ) , and learning-based token-, graph-, slice-, and line-level models ( Russell et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Fu and Tantithamthavorn, 2022 ) , though datasets and evaluations show that semantic robustness remains difficult ( Fan et al., 2020 ; Chakraborty et al., 2022 ) . Clone- and patch-driven systems use historical fixes as compact witnesses ( Jang et al., 2012 ; Li et al., 2016 ; Kim et al., 2017 ) . These motivate our use of patches to scope the refinement task.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞检测与补丁证据。 静态漏洞检测长期以来使用污点与数据流推理（Livshits and Lam, 2005; Jovanovic et al., 2006; Arzt et al., 2014）、图与AST表示（Yamaguchi et al., 2014; Yamaguchi et al., 2012），以及基于学习的词元级、图级、切片级和行级模型（Russell et al., 2018; Li et al., 2018; Li et al., 2022; Fu and Tantithamthavorn, 2022），但数据集与评估表明，语义鲁棒性仍然难以实现（Fan et al., 2020; Chakraborty et al., 2022）。 克隆与补丁驱动的系统将历史修复用作紧凑的证据（Jang et al., 2012; Li et al., 2016; Kim et al., 2017）。 这些工作促使我们使用补丁来界定细化任务的范围。

paragraphs.en: LLM-Based Checker Synthesis. Code models and repository agents support program generation and analysis ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) ; LLMDFA decomposes data-flow reasoning and synthesizes tools ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Security studies show why generated code requires validation ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Perry et al., 2023 ; Khoury et al., 2023 ) . KNighter ( Yang et al., 2025 ) is the closest workflow: it generates, compiles, edits and revalidates checkers using patch and report context. QLCoder ( Wang et al., 2025 ) synthesizes CodeQL queries from CVE metadata via an agentic loop with execution feedback and structured tool access. SemWeaver adds bounded compiler and checker observations to that setting and attempts warning recovery on silent starts.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的检查器合成。 代码模型与仓库智能体支持程序生成与分析 (Chen et al., 2021; Guo et al., 2025)；LLMDFA 将数据流推理分解并合成工具 (Wang et al., 2024)。 安全性研究说明了为何生成的代码需要验证 (Pearce et al., 2022; Perry et al., 2023; Khoury et al., 2023)。 KNighter (Yang et al., 2025) 是最接近的工作流程：它利用补丁和报告上下文来生成、编译、编辑并重新验证检查器。 QLCoder (Wang et al., 2025) 通过带有执行反馈和结构化工具访问的智能体循环，从 CVE 元数据合成 CodeQL 查询。 SemWeaver 在该设定基础上增加了有界的编译器与检查器观测，并在静默启动时尝试告警恢复。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-Guided Repair. The loop also relates to repair and synthesis under compiler, test, verifier or learned feedback ( Clarke et al., 2000 ; Solar-Lezama et al., 2006 ; Le Goues et al., 2012 ; Kim et al., 2013 ; Long and Rinard, 2015 ; Nguyen et al., 2013 ; Mechtaev et al., 2016 ; Long and Rinard, 2016 ) , and to LLM work on iterative feedback, tool use and search ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023b ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023a ) . Weak validation proxies and repair overfitting are established concerns ( Qi et al., 2015 ; Smith et al., 2015 ) . Our follow-up examines their consequences for edited static checkers, where a warning can return at the expected line while its object, scope or path remains wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈引导的修复。 该循环还与编译器、测试、验证器或学习反馈下的修复与合成相关（Clarke 等，2000；Solar-Lezama 等，2006；Le Goues 等，2012；Kim 等，2013；Long 和 Rinard，2015；Nguyen 等，2013；Mechtaev 等，2016；Long 和 Rinard，2016），也与关于迭代反馈、工具使用和搜索的大语言模型工作相关（Madaan 等，2023；Shinn 等，2023；Yao 等，2023b；Schick 等，2023；Yao 等，2023a）。 弱验证代理与修复过拟合是已有研究关注的问题（Qi 等，2015；Smith 等，2015）。 我们的后续工作考察了这些后果对被编辑的静态检查器的影响，在这种情况下，警告可能在预期的行上重新出现，而其对象、作用域或路径仍然是错误的。

paragraphs.en: Analyzer Context and Alert Triage. LLift uses analyzer reports and post-constraints ( Li et al., 2024 ) ; Chapman et al. interleave analyzer intermediates and prompting for error specifications ( Chapman et al., 2024 ) ; IRIS infers taint specifications with CodeQL ( Li et al., 2025 ) . LLM4PFA reasons about report feasibility ( Du et al., 2025 ) , and ZeroFalse enriches reports before adjudication ( Iranmanesh et al., 2025 ) . VulGenie combines patch dependencies, attack and defense flows, and API-rule synthesis ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . These studies already use analyzer context. SemWeaver instead studies how such context changes an existing checker’s implementation and the reports it produces, retaining both the useful edits and their remaining semantic errors.

paragraphs.en: Static-analysis frameworks already compute rich semantic information about how checkers interact with program representations, yet existing LLM-based refinement loops leave this information unused. SemWeaver bridges this gap by feeding analyzer-internal evidence into the editing loop, enabling the model to understand why a checker fails rather than only that it does. Evaluation on KNighter-derived Linux checkers shows that this approach recovers previously silent vulnerable revisions and improves paired discrimination over report-driven refinement alone. A qualitative follow-up traces each warning-count change to specific checker repairs, such as recognizing lowered callbacks and unwrapping expression casts, confirming that the evidence guides semantically meaningful edits. Extending this approach to verify target-level semantic correctness beyond warning presence is a promising direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析框架已经能够计算关于检查器如何与程序表示交互的丰富语义信息，但现有的基于大语言模型的细化循环却未利用这些信息。 SemWeaver 通过将分析器内部的证据输入编辑循环来弥合这一差距，使模型能够理解检查器为何失败，而不仅仅是知道它失败了。 在 KNighter 衍生的 Linux 检查器上的评估表明，该方法能够恢复此前被遗漏的存在漏洞的修订版本，并比仅依赖报告驱动的细化提升了配对区分能力。 一项定性后续分析将每次警告数量的变化追溯到具体的检查器修复，例如识别降级后的回调函数以及解包表达式强制转换，证实这些证据能够引导语义上有意义的编辑。 将该方法扩展到验证超越警告存在与否的目标级语义正确性，是一个有前景的未来工作方向。
